claim: The portable core exactly reproduces the Windows v1.014 live-player launch routine at 0x40C84F and the normal clear-air update path at 0x40A603/0x40A96F for the tested club, power, direction and swing-adjuster cases.

sources.observation: The original PE machine code was executed directly in Unicorn for the live-player launch and normal clear-air instruction ranges. Three cases produced 58 samples total with exact equality across X, Y, height, vertical force, horizontal force and direction.

notes: This verifies launch and normal clear-air state evolution only. Terrain lookup, landing, bounce/roll terminal behavior, hazards, cup capture, putter and full in-game input/profile selection remain outside this parity record. The earlier 0x40AD1D interpretation is not used as the live-player launch path.
